name: Serge
site: ckw.ch · Electricity and energy services, Switzerland
headline: Turn CKW’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells solar power, electricity tariffs and building technology to every visitor the same way, whether they are a private household or a business customer.

Once a customer is on a tariff, their consumption, solar output, EV charging times and unused services are your strongest signals for the next offer and the next switch. That signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to switch supplier this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the switch before it happens
cases.text: Per customer, the AI reads consumption shifts, solar feed-in and contact history to spot who is about to leave. It picks the offer, channel and moment for each one.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right tariff, when it fits
cases.text: Next best tariff, add-on or service per customer, triggered by their actual consumption and solar output. No more blanket tariff mailings to people already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep customers engaged with their energy data
cases.text: Personal nudges on energy use, solar yield and building services, sent by email and on your homepage, so every customer has a reason to come back.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
